title: Seafood Italian Pilaf
description: A flavorful seafood pilaf dish with Italian twist, featuring shrimp, mussels, and clams in a garlicky Croatian-inspired broth.
instructions: Heat the seafood broth in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the garlicky shrimp to the saucepan and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams to the saucepan and cover with a lid.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3-4 minutes or until the seafood is cooked through.
Stir in the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Fluff the unique rice pilaf with a fork and add to the saucepan.
Toss the pilaf with the seafood and garlic mixture.
Season with Croatian sea salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
